要旨（訳）

背景：Ivonescimabは非小細胞肺がん（NSCLC）で臨床的有効性を示している。第3世代EGFRチロシンキナーゼ阻害薬（TKI）療法後に病勢進行した進行EGFR変異NSCLC患者において、ivonescimab＋化学療法対プラセボ＋化学療法の有効性と安全性を評価することを目的とした。方法：HARMONiは、アジア、欧州、北米の114のがんセンターおよび病院で実施された無作為化プラセボ対照二重盲検第3相試験である。適格患者は18歳以上（アジアでは上限75歳）、IIIB/IIIC期またはIV期の非扁平上皮EGFR変異NSCLC、第3世代EGFR-TKI治療後の病勢進行、Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance statusスコア0または1であった。患者は中央の対話型音声応答システムまたは対話型ウェブ応答システムにより1:1で、ivonescimab（20 mg/kg）またはプラセボにpemetrexed（500 mg/m²）およびcarboplatin（目標AUC 5 mg/mL/min）を3週ごと静脈内投与する群に無作為割付けされた。無作為化は登録時の脳転移の有無および地理的地域で層別した。主要評価項目は、盲検独立画像評価委員会による無増悪生存期間およびintention-to-treat集団における全生存期間であった。安全性は試験治療を少なくとも1回投与された患者で評価した。本試験はClinicalTrials.govに登録され（NCT06396065）、登録は完了し、治療および追跡は継続中である。結果：2022年1月25日から2024年10月1日までに660例が適格性をスクリーニングされ、うち438例が登録されivonescimab＋化学療法またはプラセボ＋化学療法に無作為割付けされた（各群219例）。登録患者のうち女性257例（59%）、男性181例（41%）；人種をアジア人と報告したのは306例（70%）、白人は105例（24%）であった。追跡期間中央値22.3か月（95% CI 21.5–23.0）時点で、345例中275件の進行または死亡イベントが発生していた（ivonescimab＋化学療法群172例中129件、プラセボ＋化学療法群173例中146件）。無増悪生存期間の中央値は、ivonescimab＋化学療法群6.8か月（95% CI 5.7–7.1）、プラセボ＋化学療法群4.4か月（4.1–5.5）であった（ハザード比［HR］0.52；95% CI 0.41–0.66；p<0.0001）。追跡期間中央値29.7か月（95% CI 27.7–31.0）時点で、438例中262例が死亡した（ivonescimab＋化学療法群122例、プラセボ＋化学療法群140例）。全生存期間の中央値は、ivonescimab＋化学療法群16.8か月（14.3–19.0）、プラセボ＋化学療法群14.0か月（12.8–15.7）であった（HR 0.79；0.62–1.01）。最も頻度の高いGrade 3–4治療関連有害事象は、ivonescimab＋化学療法群対プラセボ＋化学療法群で、好中球数減少（218例中42例［19%］対218例中36例［17%］）、白血球数減少（28例［13%］対24例［11%］）、血小板数減少（27例［12%］対14例［6%］）、貧血（22例［10%］対27例［12%］）であった。重篤な治療関連有害事象は、ivonescimab＋化学療法群61例（28%）、プラセボ＋化学療法群33例（15%）に生じた。治療関連有害事象による死亡は、ivonescimab＋化学療法群4例（病勢進行、多臓器機能不全症候群、肝不全が各1例；消化管出血および肺塞栓が1例）、プラセボ＋化学療法群5例（肺臓炎、心筋梗塞、脳血管事故、認知障害、塞栓性脳卒中が各1例）であった。解釈：Ivonescimab＋化学療法は、EGFR-TKI療法後に進行したEGFR変異NSCLC患者において、臨床的に意味があり統計学的に有意な無増悪生存期間の利益を示した。ivonescimabと化学療法の臨床的利益および新たな安全性シグナルの欠如は、本患者集団における新たな治療選択肢としての併用の可能性を支持する。資金提供：Summit Therapeutics。

Abstract (original)

BACKGROUND: Ivonescimab has shown clinical efficacy in non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC). We aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of ivonescimab plus chemotherapy versus placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with advanced EGFR-mutated NSCLC whose disease progressed after third-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy. METHODS: HARMONi is a randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind, phase 3 trial done at 114 cancer centres and hospitals across Asia, Europe, and North America. Eligible patients were aged at least 18 years (upper limit: 75 years in Asia) with stage IIIB/IIIC or IV non-squamous EGFR-mutated NSCLC, disease progression after treatment with a third-generation EGFR-TKI, and an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status score of 0 or 1. Patients were randomly assigned (1:1) via a centralised interactive voice response system or interactive web response system to receive ivonescimab (20 mg/kg) or placebo plus pemetrexed (500 mg/m2) and carboplatin (target area under the curve 5 mg/mL per min) intravenously every 3 weeks. Randomisation was stratified by brain metastases status at enrolment and geographical region. The primary endpoints were progression-free survival by blinded independent radiology review committee and overall survival in the intention-to-treat population. Safety was assessed in patients who received at least one dose of trial treatment. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06396065), has completed enrolment, and is ongoing for treatment and follow-up. FINDINGS: From Jan 25, 2022, to Oct 1, 2024, 660 individuals were screened for eligibility; of these, 438 were enrolled and randomly assigned to receive ivonescimab plus chemotherapy or placebo plus chemotherapy (219 per group). Of enrolled patients, 257 (59%) were female and 181 (41%) were male; 306 (70%) reported race as Asian, and 105 (24%) as White. At a median follow-up of 22·3 months (95% CI 21·5-23·0), 275 progression or death events had occurred in 345 patients (129 events among 172 patients in the ivonescimab plus chemotherapy group and 146 events among 173 patients in the placebo plus chemotherapy group). Median progression-free survival was 6·8 months (95% CI 5·7-7·1) in the ivonescimab plus chemotherapy group versus 4·4 months (4·1-5·5) in the placebo plus chemotherapy group (hazard ratio [HR] 0·52; 95% CI 0·41-0·66; p<0·0001). At a median follow-up of 29·7 months (95% CI 27·7-31·0), 262 deaths occurred in 438 patients (122 in the ivonescimab plus chemotherapy group and 140 in the placebo plus chemotherapy group). Median overall survival was 16·8 months (14·3-19·0) in the ivonescimab plus chemotherapy group versus 14·0 months (12·8-15·7) in the placebo plus chemotherapy group (HR 0·79; 0·62-1·01). The most common grade 3-4 treatment-related adverse events in the ivonescimab plus chemotherapy versus the placebo plus chemotherapy group were decreased neutrophil count (42 [19%] of 218 vs 36 [17%] of 218), decreased white blood cell count (28 [13%] vs 24 [11%]), decreased platelet count (27 [12%] vs 14 [6%]), and anaemia (22 [10%] vs 27 [12%]). Serious treatment-related adverse events occurred in 61 (28%) patients in the ivonescimab plus chemotherapy group and 33 (15%) patients in the placebo plus chemotherapy group. Treatment-related adverse events led to death in four patients (disease progression, multiple organ dysfunction syndrome, and hepatic failure, each in one patient; gastrointestinal haemorrhage and pulmonary embolism in one patient) in the ivonescimab plus chemotherapy group and five patients (pneumonitis, myocardial infarction, cerebrovascular accident, cognitive disorder, and embolic stroke, each in one patient) in the placebo plus chemotherapy group. INTERPRETATION: Ivonescimab plus chemotherapy showed a clinically meaningful and statistically significant progression-free survival benefit in patients with EGFR-mutated NSCLC after progression on EGFR-TKI therapy. The clinical benefit and lack of new safety signals of ivonescimab with chemotherapy support the potential for the combination as a new treatment option in this patient population. FUNDING: Summit Therapeutics.

DOI: 10.1016/s1470-2045(26)00282-2 · PMID: 42636833

item.title: Adjuvant alectinib versus chemotherapy in resected ALK-positive non-small-cell lung cancer (ALINA): health-related quality-of-life and safety outcomes from a randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial. / The Lancet Oncology / 2026-08
item.description:
掲載誌

The Lancet Oncology (2026-08-24) · 優先誌

Vol.27 · No.9 · ISSN 1470-2045 · IF 2025 33.7

著者

Dziadziuszko Rafal, Ahn Jin Seok, Barlesi Fabrice, Solomon Benjamin J, Wu Yi-Long, Bondarenko Igor, Hochmair Maximilian, Horinouchi Hidehito, Lee Dae Ho, Lee Jong-Seok, Planchard David, Rittmeyer Achim, Zhong Wenzhao, Adler Leah, Archer Venice, Cardona Andres, Petric Patricia, Scalori Astrid, Ding Beiying, Mamolo Carla, Smoljanovic Vlatka, Nishio Makoto

所属・国

  • Gdańsk Medical University — ポーランド
  • Samsung Medical Center — 韓国
  • Université Paris-Saclay — フランス
  • Institut Gustave Roussy — フランス
  • Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre — オーストラリア
  • Guangdong Academy of Medical Sciences — 中国
  • Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital — 中国
  • Southern Medical University — 中国
  • Dnipro State Medical University — UA
  • Karl Landsteiner Society — オーストリア
  • Institut für Lungenforschung — ドイツ

  • Roche (Switzerland) — スイス
  • Roche (United Kingdom) — イギリス
  • Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Institute — アメリカ
  • Japanese Foundation For Cancer Research — 日本

要旨（訳）

切除されたALK陽性非小細胞肺がん（NSCLC）患者において、国際第3相非盲検無作為化ALINA試験で、adjuvant alectinibはプラチナベース化学療法に対し無病生存期間を有意に改善した。ALINA試験の安全性および健康関連生活の質（HRQoL）転帰を報告する。18歳以上、切除されたALK陽性、IB期（4 cm以上）–IIIA期NSCLC（American Joint Committee on CancerおよびUnion for International Cancer Control Cancer Staging Manual第7版に準拠）、Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status 0–1の適格患者を、ブロック層別無作為化法により1:1で、経口alectinib（600 mg 1日2回）24か月または静脈内プラチナベース化学療法4サイクル（3週ごと）に無作為割付けした。無作為化は病期および人種で層別した。主要評価項目である無病生存期間は既報である。安全性は副次評価項目、HRQoLは探索的評価項目であった。安全性は、alectinib最終投与後または化学療法サイクル後28日まで、National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 5.0に従い治験責任医師が評価した。HRQoLはShort-Form 36-item health survey version 2（SF-36v2）質問票により、ベースライン、12週まで3週ごと、その後病勢再発、同意撤回、死亡、または96週まで12週ごとに評価した。ノルムベーススコアを適用し、臨床的に意味のある変化はSF-36v2マニュアルに従って定義した。安全性は安全性評価可能集団、HRQoLはintention-to-treat集団で評価した。本試験はClinicalTrials.govに登録され（NCT03456076）、継続中である。2018年8月16日から2021年12月8日までに257例がalectinib（n=130）または化学療法（n=127）に割付けられた。男性123例（48%）、女性134例（52%）；アジア人143例（56%）であった。安全性評価可能集団はalectinibを受けた128例および化学療法を受けた120例からなり、安全性追跡期間中央値はalectinib群24.8か月（IQR 22.0–24.9）、化学療法群3.7か月（IQR 3.7–3.8）であった。adjuvant alectinibの安全性は概して既知のプロファイルと一致していた。最も頻度の高いGrade 3–4有害事象は、alectinib群では血中クレアチンホスホキナーゼ上昇（128例中8例［6%］）、アラニンアミノトランスフェラーゼ上昇（128例中2例［2%］）、血中ビリルビン上昇（128例中2例［2%］）、化学療法群では好中球数減少（120例中12例［10%］）、好中球減少症（120例中10例［8%］）、悪心（120例中5例［4%］）であった。重篤な治療関連有害事象は、alectinib群128例中2例（2%；虫垂炎および肺臓炎が各1例）、化学療法群120例中8例（7%）（最も頻度が高かったのは消化器障害3例［3%］）に生じた。いずれの群でも有害事象による死亡は報告されなかった。有害事象による中止はalectinib（7例［5%］）の方が化学療法（15例［13%］）より少なかった。alectinibでは、12週時点でSF-36v2の身体の痛み、役割身体、精神的健康、社会生活機能、活力ドメインにおいてベースラインからの改善に臨床的に意味のある差が認められた。身体的および精神的HRQoLの改善は実薬治療2年間維持され（96週時点、Mental Component Summaryスコア平均：49.9［SD 10.4］；Physical Component Summaryスコア平均：48.8［SD 7.2］）、一般集団と同程度の水準に達した（集団ノルム：50）。切除されたALK陽性NSCLC患者において、adjuvant alectinibは管理可能な安全性プロファイルを有し、HRQoLは改善し実薬治療2年間維持された。ALINAで認められた無病生存期間の利益と合わせ、これらのデータは切除ALK陽性NSCLC患者に対する重要な新たな標準治療としてadjuvant alectinibを支持する。F. Hoffmann-La Roche。

Abstract (original)

For patients with resected, ALK-positive non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC), adjuvant alectinib significantly improved disease-free survival versus platinum-based chemotherapy in the global, phase 3, open-label, randomised ALINA trial. We report safety and health-related quality-of-life (HRQoL) outcomes from the ALINA trial. Eligible patients aged 18 years or older with resected, ALK-positive, stage IB (≥4 cm)-IIIA NSCLC (per the American Joint Committee on Cancer and the Union for International Cancer Control Cancer Staging Manual 7th edition) and an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0-1 were randomly assigned (1:1) via a block-stratified randomisation method to receive oral alectinib (600 mg twice daily) for 24 months or intravenous platinum-based chemotherapy for four 3-week cycles. Randomisation was stratified according to disease stage and race. The primary endpoint, previously reported, was disease-free survival. Safety was a secondary endpoint and HRQoL was an exploratory endpoint. Safety was assessed by the investigator as per the National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events version 5·0 until 28 days after the last alectinib dose or chemotherapy cycle. HRQoL was assessed via the Short-Form 36-item health survey version 2 (SF-36v2) questionnaire at baseline, every 3 weeks to week 12, then every 12 weeks until disease recurrence, consent withdrawal, death, or week 96. Norm-based scoring was applied; clinically meaningful changes were defined using the SF-36v2 manual. Safety was assessed in the safety-evaluable population and HRQoL in the intention-to-treat population. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03456076) and is ongoing. Between Aug 16, 2018, and Dec 8, 2021, 257 patients were assigned to receive alectinib (n=130) or chemotherapy (n=127). 123 (48%) patients were male and 134 (52%) were female; 143 (56%) were Asian. The safety-evaluable population comprised 128 patients who received alectinib and 120 patients who received chemotherapy; median duration of safety follow-up was 24·8 months (IQR 22·0-24·9) in the alectinib group and 3·7 months (IQR 3·7-3·8) in the chemotherapy group. The safety of adjuvant alectinib was generally consistent with its known profile. The most common grade 3-4 adverse events were blood creatine phosphokinase increased (eight [6%] of 128), alanine aminotransferase increased (two [2%] of 128), and blood bilirubin increased (two [2%] of 128) in the alectinib group, and neutrophil count decreased (12 [10%] of 120), neutropenia (ten [8%] of 120), and nausea (five [4%] of 120) in the chemotherapy group. Serious treatment-related adverse events occurred in two (2%; one each with appendicitis and pneumonitis) of 128 patients in the alectinib group and eight (7%) of 120 patients in the chemotherapy group ( most common were gastrointestinal disorders in three [3%] patients). No deaths due to adverse events were reported in either group. There were fewer discontinuations due to adverse events with alectinib (seven [5%]) versus chemotherapy (15 [13%]). A clinically meaningful difference in improvement from baseline was seen at week 12 for bodily pain, role physical, mental health, social functioning, and vitality SF-36v2 domains with alectinib; improvements in physical and mental HRQoL were maintained over 2 years of active treatment (at week 96, mean Mental Component Summary score: 49·9 [SD 10·4]; mean Physical Component Summary score: 48·8 [SD 7·2]) and reached levels similar to the general population (population norm: 50). For patients with resected ALK-positive NSCLC, adjuvant alectinib had a manageable safety profile; HRQoL improved and was maintained over 2 years of active treatment. Together with the disease-free survival benefit seen in ALINA, these data support adjuvant alectinib as an important new standard-of-care for patients with resected ALK-positive NSCLC. F Hoffmann-La Roche.

DOI: 10.1016/s1470-2045(26)00283-4 · PMID: 42636834

item.title: SHR-A2102, a nectin-4 directed antibody-drug conjugate, in patients with pretreated advanced solid tumours: a multicentre, single-arm, phase 1 trial. / The Lancet Oncology / 2026-08

Zhong Runbo, Hong Huangming, Yan Min, Wang Qiming, Zhang Yan, Lan Qiongyu, Luo Yongzhong, Zhang Ling, Xu Haipeng, Guo Sanxing, Guo Wei, Ma Jie, Zhang Longzhen, Wu Lin, Liu Zhigang, He Wei, Sun Yubei, Chen Kai, Huang Jiangqiong, Han Guang, Nian Weiqi, Zhang Ming, Ren Shengxiang, Qiao Rong, Li Xiang, Yu Meijing, Hu Jin, Huang Yanhua, Song Li, Shi Wei, Zhong Hua

要旨（訳）

背景：SHR-A2102は、完全ヒトnectin-4指向性モノクローナル抗体が切断可能なリンカーを介してトポイソメラーゼI阻害薬ペイロードに結合した新規抗体薬物複合体である。進行固形腫瘍におけるSHR-A2102の安全性、予備的活性、薬物動態を評価するため第1相試験を実施した。方法：本多施設単群第1相試験は中国の39病院で実施され、用量漸増（Bayesian Optimal Intervalデザイン）、薬物動態拡大、有効性拡大の段階を含んだ。適格患者は18歳以上、標準療法後に進行した、不耐であった、または利用可能な標準療法がない切除不能局所進行または転移性固形腫瘍を有し、Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance statusスコア0または1であった。患者はSHR-A2102を2–10 mg/kgで3週ごと1回静脈内投与された。主要評価項目は安全性、用量制限毒性、最大耐量、推奨第2相用量であった。SHR-A2102を少なくとも1回投与された全患者を安全性および活性解析に含めた。本試験はClinicalTrials.govに登録され（NCT05701709）、継続中である。結果：2023年4月17日から2025年2月20日までに、395例（年齢中央値59歳［IQR 53–66］；男性239例［61%］、女性156例［39%］；395例［100%］が中国人）が各試験段階に登録・治療され、非小細胞肺がん197例、ホルモン受容体陽性HER2陰性乳がん32例、トリプルネガティブ乳がん36例、食道扁平上皮がん77例、頭頸部扁平上皮がん26例、その他の固形腫瘍27例を含んだ。データカットオフ（2025年6月20日）時点で、追跡期間中央値は7.2か月（IQR 4.7–9.7）であった。用量漸増段階のデータに基づき、6 mg/kg（n=10）および8 mg/kg（n=11）が薬物動態拡大に選択された。用量漸増中、10 mg/kgで用量制限毒性が1件報告された（Grade 4血小板数減少）；最大耐量には到達しなかった。Grade 3–4治療関連有害事象は395例中212例（54%）に報告され、最も頻度が高かったのは好中球数減少（118例［30%］）、白血球数減少（75例［19%］）、貧血（69例［17%］）であった。治療関連重篤有害事象は98例（25%）に報告され、最も頻度が高かったのは肺炎（21例［5%］）であった。治療関連死亡は2例（<1%）に生じた（肺塞栓および肺炎）。解釈：SHR-A2102はトポイソメラーゼI阻害薬ペイロードと一致する安全性プロファイルを示し、抗がん治療歴のある各種進行固形腫瘍患者において有望な活性を示した。各種腫瘍型で一定範囲の活性用量が同定された。進行固形腫瘍におけるSHR-A2102の単剤または併用評価のため、複数の試験が進行中である。資金提供：Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals。

Abstract (original)

BACKGROUND: SHR-A2102 is a new antibody-drug conjugate consisting of a fully human nectin-4-directed monoclonal antibody bound to a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload via a cleavable linker. We did a phase 1 trial to evaluate the safety, preliminary activity, and pharmacokinetics of SHR-A2102 in advanced solid tumours. METHODS: This multicentre, single-arm, phase 1 trial was done at 39 hospitals in China and included dose-escalation (Bayesian Optimal Interval design), pharmacokinetic-expansion, and efficacy-expansion stages. Eligible patients were aged at least 18 years, had unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic solid tumours that had progressed after, were intolerant to, or had no available standard therapy, and had an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status score of 0 or 1. Patients received SHR-A2102 intravenously at doses of 2-10 mg/kg once every 3 weeks. The primary endpoints were safety, dose-limiting toxicity, maximum tolerated dose, and recommended phase 2 dose. All patients who received at least one dose of SHR-A2102 were included in the safety and activity analyses. This trial is registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05701709) and is ongoing. FINDINGS: Between April 17, 2023 and Feb 20, 2025, 395 patients (median age 59 years [IQR 53-66]; 239 [61%] male and 156 [39%] female; 395 [100%] Chinese) were enrolled and treated across study stages, including 197 with non-small cell lung cancer, 32 with hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer, 36 with triple-negative breast cancer, 77 with oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma, 26 with head-and-neck squamous-cell carcinoma, and 27 with other solid tumours. As of data cutoff (June 20, 2025), the median follow-up was 7·2 months (IQR 4·7-9·7). Based on data from the dose-escalation stage, 6 mg/kg (n=10) and 8 mg/kg (n=11) were selected for pharmacokinetic expansion. During dose escalation, one dose-limiting toxicity was reported at 10 mg/kg (grade 4 decreased platelet count); maximum tolerated dose was not reached. Grade 3-4 treatment-related adverse events were reported in 212 (54%) of 395 patients, with the most common being decreased neutrophil count (118 [30%]), decreased white-blood-cell count (75 [19%]), and anaemia (69 [17%]). Treatment-related serious adverse events were reported in 98 (25%) patients with the most common being pneumonia (21 [5%]). Treatment-related deaths occurred in two (<1%) patients (pulmonary embolism and pneumonia). INTERPRETATION: SHR-A2102 demonstrated a safety profile consistent with its topoisomerase I inhibitor payload and showed promising activity in patients with various advanced solid tumours who had previously received anti-cancer treatment. A range of active dose was identified in various tumour types. Several trials are ongoing to evaluate SHR-A2102, either as monotherapy or in combination, in advanced solid tumours. item.title: Ifebemtinib plus garsorasib in previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer with KRASG12C mutation: a multicentre, randomised, phase 1b/2 trial. / The Lancet Oncology / 2026-08
item.description:
掲載誌

The Lancet Oncology (2026-08-24) · 優先誌

Vol.27 · No.9 · ISSN 1470-2045 · IF 2025 33.7

著者

Song Zhengbo, Zhu Liming, Liu Ying, Lin Rongbo, Li Xingya, Luo Yongzhong, Yuan Yuan, Shi Huaqiu, Zhang Yiping, Zhang Baoyuan, Zhu Yinxin, Wang Zaiqi, Cheng Xiangdong

所属・国

要旨（訳）

背景：Ifebemtinibは強力な経口focal adhesion kinase阻害薬である。前臨床エビデンスはifebemtinibとKRASG12C阻害薬garsorasibの併用を支持する。本研究はKRASG12C変異固形腫瘍における本併用を評価することを目的とした。方法：本多施設第1b/2相試験は、推奨第2相用量を確立する第1b相コンポーネントと、第2相多腫瘍拡大コンポーネントからなる。第1b相では、3+3デザインを用いKRASG12C変異固形腫瘍においてifebemtinibとgarsorasib併用の安全性および忍容性を評価した。用量制限毒性は観察されず、推奨第2相用量はifebemtinib 100 mg経口1日1回＋garsorasib 600 mg経口1日2回と確立された。ここでは、第2相拡大の既治療KRASG12C変異転移性大腸がんコホートの結果を報告する。組織学的に確認されたKRASG12C変異を有する局所進行または転移性大腸がん、Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance-statusスコア0または1、既往のirinotecanベースまたはoxaliplatinベース併用療法後の病勢進行を有する適格患者（18歳以上）を、中国の参加9三次病院のうち7施設から募集した。推奨第2相用量に基づき、第2相はifebemtinib＋garsorasibの安全性および有効性を評価する単群試験と、層別なしの中央コンピュータ生成ブロック無作為化によりifebemtinib＋garsorasibまたはgarsorasib単独に1:1で無作為割付けする非盲検無作為化試験からなった。治験責任医師はブロックサイズをマスクされた。第2相の主要有効性評価項目は治験責任医師評価による客観的奏効率（Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours, version 1.1）であり、単群試験では安全性解析対象集団、無作為化試験では無作為割付け全患者（intention-to-treat集団）で評価した。無作為化試験へ進むには、単群試験（安全性解析対象集団）で少なくとも6件の客観的奏効が必要であった。本試験はClinicalTrials.govに登録され（NCT06166836およびNCT05379946）、活動中であるが登録は終了している。結果：2023年4月7日から2024年12月13日までに、51例が第2相に登録された（単群試験15例、無作為化試験36例）。単群試験では、年齢中央値53歳（IQR 39–63）、女性9例（60%）、男性6例（40%）、全例がアジア人であった。無作為化試験では、年齢中央値は併用群51歳（IQR 42–59）、単剤群63歳（IQR 54–66）、女性24例（67%）、男性12例（33%）、全例がアジア人であった。単群パートでは、確定客観的奏効率は46.7%（95% CI 21.3–73.4）であった。7例が部分奏効を示し、無作為化試験への進行が発動された。無作為化試験では、確定客観的奏効率は併用療法38.9%（95% CI 17.3–64.3）対garsorasib単独16.7%（95% CI 3.6–41.4）であった（群間差22.2%、95% CI −7.7–49.1；片側p=0.068）。単群試験ではGrade 3治療関連有害事象が15例中4例（27%）に生じ、無作為化試験では併用群18例中6例（33%）、garsorasib群18例中5例（28%）にGrade 3治療関連有害事象が生じた。少なくとも2例に生じたGrade 3治療関連有害事象は、併用療法（合算）では下痢（6例［18%］）、蛋白尿（2例［6%］）、腸閉塞（2例［6%］）、garsorasib単独ではアラニンアミノトランスフェラーゼ上昇およびγ-グルタミルトランスフェラーゼ上昇（各2例［11%］）であった。重篤な有害事象は併用群10例（30%）、単剤群4例（22%）に生じた。garsorasib単剤群の1例が試験治療完了後30日以内に原疾患により死亡し、重篤な有害事象として報告された。死亡は治験責任医師によりgarsorasib非関連と判断された。全コホートを通じてGrade 4治療関連有害事象または治療関連死亡は報告されなかった。解釈：Ifebemtinibとgarsorasibの併用は、既治療のKRASG12C変異転移性大腸がん患者において有望な抗がん活性と管理可能な安全性プロファイルを示した。無作為化試験で奏効率の改善は統計学的有意性に達しなかったものの、これらの所見は本集団におけるifebemtinib＋garsorasibのさらなる評価を支持する。資金提供：InxMed、InventisBio、国家自然科学基金、浙江省Jian Bing Ling Yan + X研究開発プログラム、浙江省医療衛生科学技術計画プロジェクト。

Abstract (original)

BACKGROUND: Ifebemtinib is a potent oral focal adhesion kinase inhibitor. Preclinical evidence supports combining ifebemtinib with the KRASG12C inhibitor garsorasib. This study aimed to evaluate this combination in KRASG12C-mutated solid tumours. METHODS: This multicentre, phase 1b/2 study had a phase 1b component to establish the recommended phase 2 dose and a phase 2 multitumour expansion component. In phase 1b, the safety and tolerability of ifebemtinib combined with garsorasib was assessed using a 3 + 3 design in KRASG12C-mutated solid tumours. No dose-limiting toxic effects were observed, and the recommended phase 2 dose was established as ifebemtinib 100 mg orally once daily plus garsorasib 600 mg orally twice daily. Here, we report the results of the cohort of previously treated KRASG12C-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer from phase 2 expansion. Eligible patients (aged ≥18 years) who had histologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer harbouring the KRASG12C mutation, an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance-status score of 0 or 1, and had disease progression after previous irinotecan-based or oxaliplatin-based combination therapy, were recruited from seven of nine participating tertiary hospitals in China. On the basis of the recommended phase 2 dose, phase 2 comprised a single-arm study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of ifebemtinib combined with garsorasib and an open-label, randomised study in which patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive ifebemtinib plus garsorasib or garsorasib alone, by use of centralised computer-generated block randomisation with no stratification. Investigators were masked to the block size. The primary efficacy endpoint of phase 2 was investigator-assessed objective response rate (Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours, version 1.1), assessed in the safety analysis set in the single-arm study and in all randomly assigned patients (intention-to-treat population) in the randomised study. At least six objective responses (safety analysis set) were required in the single-arm study to proceed to the randomised study. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT06166836 and NCT05379946, and is active but not recruiting. FINDINGS: Between April 7, 2023 and Dec 13, 2024, 51 patients were enrolled in phase 2 (15 in the single-arm study and 36 in the randomised study). In the single-arm study, the median age was 53 years (IQR 39 to 63), nine (60%) patients were female, six (40%) were male, and all were Asian. In the randomised study, the median age was 51 years (IQR 42 to 59) in the combination group and 63 years (IQR 54 to 66) in the monotherapy group, 24 (67%) were female, 12 (33%) were male, and all patients were Asian. In the single-arm part, the confirmed objective response rate was 46·7% (95% CI 21·3 to 73·4). Seven patients had partial responses, triggering progression to the randomised study. In the randomised study, the confirmed objective response rate was 38·9% (95% CI 17·3 to 64·3) with the combination therapy versus 16·7% (95% CI 3·6 to 41·4) with garsorasib alone (between-group difference 22·2%, 95% CI -7·7 to 49·1; one-sided p=0·068). In the single-arm study, grade 3 treatment-related adverse events occurred in four (27%) of 15 patients, and in the randomised study, grade 3 treatment-related adverse events occurred in six (33%) of 18 patients in the combination group and five (28%) of 18 in the garsorasib group. Grade 3 treatment-related adverse events occurring in at least two patients were diarrhoea (six [18%]), proteinuria (two [6%]), and intestinal obstruction (two [6%]) in patients treated with combination therapy (combined), and increased alanine aminotransferase and γ-glutamyltransferase (two [11%] each) in patients treated with garsorasib alone. Serious adverse events occurred in ten (30%) patients in the combination group and in four (22%) patients in the monotherapy group. One patient in the garsorasib monotherapy group died due to the underlying malignancy within 30 days after completing study treatment, which was reported as a serious adverse event. The death was assessed by the investigators as not related to garsorasib. No grade 4 treatment-related adverse events or treatment-related deaths were reported across all cohorts. INTERPRETATION: The combination of ifebemtinib and garsorasib showed promising anticancer activity and manageable safety profile in previously treated patients with KRASG12C-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer. Although the improvement in response rate did not reach statistical significance in the randomised study, these findings support further evaluation of ifebemtinib plus garsorasib in this population. FUNDING: InxMed, InventisBio, National Natural Science Foundation of China, the Jian Bing Ling Yan + X Research and Development Program of Zhejiang Province, and the Zhejiang Province Medical and Health Science and Technology Plan Project.

item.title: Chemoradiotherapy versus short-course radiotherapy for response-adapted organ preservation in early-stage and intermediate-stage rectal cancer (STAR-TREC): 12-month results of an international, multicentre, open-label, parallel-group, randomised, phase 2/3 trial. / The Lancet Oncology / 2026-08

要旨（訳）

背景：全直腸間膜切除（TME）は、ほとんどの早期および中間期直腸がんに対する標準治療であるが、相当な周術期合併症、機能障害、および生活の質の低下をきたしうる。長期化学放射線療法（LCCRT）または短期放射線療法（SCRT）が、腫瘍学的転帰を損なわずに臓器温存を増加させ、手術、毒性、生活の質への害を減らせるかを評価した。方法：STAR-TRECは、欧州5か国における国際多施設共同非盲検並行群無作為化第2/3相試験である。適格患者は、英国では16歳以上、その他では18歳以上、Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group（ECOG）performance status 0–1、直腸腺癌（mrT1–T3bN0、40 mm以下）であった。第2相では、参加者を1:1:1でLCCRTに基づく臓器温存（LCCRT-OP；50 Gyを25分割＋経口capecitabine 825 mg/m² 1日2回）、SCRTに基づく臓器温存（SCRT-OP；25 Gyを5分割）、または一次TMEに無作為割付けした。第2相は実現可能性を評価し、主要評価項目は12か月および24か月時点の登録であり、実現可能性閾値はそれぞれ月4例以上および月6例以上の無作為化であった。第3相は部分無作為化患者選好デザインを採用し、参加者が臓器温存またはTMEを選択できるようにした。臓器温存を選択した参加者は、国およびMRI T分類（T3a以下対T3b）で層別した最小化法による中央コンピュータ生成割付けを用い、1:1でLCCRT-OPまたはSCRT-OPに無作為割付けされた。第3相の主要評価項目は治療開始後30か月の臓器温存であり、TME、ストーマ、または局所再発がないことと定義し、第2相および第3相の参加者を含む修正intention-to-treat集団で評価した。非マスク第2相データの計画された中間解析後、試験運営委員会および独立データモニタリング委員会は、2023年8月8日以前に登録された参加者について、実施転帰の12か月修正intention-to-treat解析の報告を推奨した。本試験はISRCTNに登録され（14240288）、終了している。結果：2017年6月14日から2024年4月8日までに、37施設で503例が登録された。第2相は120例を登録し、12か月および24か月時点の登録率はそれぞれ月3例および月6例であった。全体として、12か月TME非施行生存は60%（78例中47例）であった。第3相登録終了後、非マスク第2相データの中間解析では、LCCRTがSCRTに対し早期のTME非施行生存利益を示した（12か月TME非施行生存中央値は未到達［95% CI 未到達–未到達］対7.6か月［95% CI 6.4–未到達］；ハザード比［HR］3.7［95% CI 1.7–8.0］；優越性の事後確率>99.5%）。したがって試験運営委員会および独立データモニタリング委員会は、2023年8月8日以前に登録された426例（第2相120例、第3相306例）の拡大解析を推奨した。17例が治療前に撤回し、修正intention-to-treat集団は409例（LCCRT 163例、SCRT 168例、一次TME 78例）となった。女性116例（28%）、男性293例（72%）であった。臓器温存を選択した参加者における12か月TME非施行生存は、LCCRTで78.5%（95% CI 72.4–85.1）、SCRTで60.6%（53.6–68.4）であった（HR 1.90［95% CI 1.29–2.81］）。最も頻度の高いGrade 3–4の重篤有害事象は、消化器障害（LCCRT 4例［2%］対SCRT 6例［4%］対TME 6例［8%］）および手技合併症（LCCRT 3例［2%］対SCRT 5例［3%］対TME 5例［6%］）であった。一次TMEに割付けられた1例が吻合部漏出後に死亡した。解釈：これらの早期結果は、反応適応型臓器温存アプローチを支持し、12か月時点ではLCCRTがSCRTより有効であるように見える。臓器温存は、一次TMEと比較して治療関連毒性を減らせる可能性もある。事前規定の30か月評価項目および確定的な機能的・腫瘍学的転帰には、より長期の追跡が必要である。資金提供：Cancer Research UK、Stand Up to Cancer、Dutch Cancer Society、Danish Cancer Society、Kom Op Tegen Kanker、Cancerfonden、ALF Region Stockholm、RCC Region Stockholm。

Abstract (original)

BACKGROUND: Total mesorectal excision (TME) is the standard treatment for most early-stage and intermediate-stage rectal cancer but can cause substantial perioperative morbidity, functional impairment, and reduced quality of life. We assessed whether long-course chemoradiotherapy (LCCRT) or short-course radiotherapy (SCRT) could increase organ preservation and reduce surgery, toxicity, and quality-of-life harms without compromising oncological outcomes. METHODS: STAR-TREC is an international, multicentre, open-label, parallel-group, randomised, phase 2/3 trial in five European countries. Eligible patients were aged 16 years or older in the UK or aged 18 years or older elsewhere, had an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-1, and rectal adenocarcinoma (≤40 mm staged as mrT1-T3bN0). In phase 2, participants were randomly assigned (1:1:1) to LCCRT-based organ preservation (LCCRT-OP; 50 Gy in 25 fractions plus oral capecitabine 825 mg/m2 twice daily), SCRT-based organ preservation (SCRT-OP; 25 Gy in five fractions), or primary TME. Phase 2 assessed feasibility, with recruitment at months 12 and 24 as the primary endpoint and feasibility thresholds of four or more and six or more randomisations per month, respectively. Phase 3 adopted a partially randomised patient-preference design, allowing participants to choose either organ preservation or TME. Participants that chose organ preservation were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive LCCRT-OP or SCRT-OP using centralised, computer-generated assignment, with stratification by country and MRI T category (≤T3a vs T3b) using minimisation. The phase 3 primary endpoint was organ-preservation 30 months after treatment initiation, defined as absence of TME, stoma, or local recurrence, which was assessed in the modified intention-to-treat population, which included participants in phase 2 and phase 3. After a planned interim analysis of unmasked phase 2 data, the trial steering committee and independent data monitoring committee recommended reporting a 12-month, modified intention-to-treat analysis of implementation outcomes for participants recruited before Aug 8, 2023. This study is registered with ISRCTN (14240288) and is closed. FINDINGS: Between June 14, 2017, and April 8, 2024, 503 participants were enrolled at 37 sites. Phase 2 enrolled 120 participants, with recruitment rates of three and six participants per month at months 12 and 24, respectively. Overall, 12-month TME-free survival was 60% (47 of 78 participants). After phase 3 recruitment ended, interim analysis of unmasked phase 2 data showed an early TME-free survival benefit with LCCRT versus SCRT (12-month median TME-free survival not reached [95% CI not reached-not reached] vs 7·6 months [95% CI 6·4-not reached]; hazard ratio [HR] 3·7 [95% CI 1·7-8·0]; posterior probability of superiority >99·5%). The trial steering committee and independent data monitoring committee therefore recommended expanded analysis of 426 participants recruited before Aug 8, 2023: 120 from phase 2 and 306 from phase 3. 17 participants withdrew before treatment, leaving 409 in the modified intention-to-treat population: 163 allocated to LCCRT, 168 to SCRT, and 78 to primary TME. 116 (28%) participants were female and 293 (72%) were male. Among participants who opted for organ preservation, 12-month TME-free survival was 78·5% (95% CI 72·4-85·1) with LCCRT and 60·6% (53·6-68·4) with SCRT (HR 1·90 [95% CI 1·29-2·81]). The most common grade 3-4 serious adverse events were gastrointestinal disorders (four [2%] with LCCRT vs six [4%] with SCRT vs six [8%] with TME) and procedural complications (three [2%] with LCCRT vs five [3%] with SCRT vs five [6%] with TME). One participant allocated to primary TME died after an anastomotic leak. INTERPRETATION: These early results support a response-adapted organ-preservation approach, with LCCRT appearing more effective than SCRT at 12 months. Organ-preservation might also reduce treatment-related toxicity compared with primary TME. Longer follow-up is needed for the prespecified 30-month endpoint and definitive functional and oncological outcomes. FUNDING: Cancer Research UK, Stand Up to Cancer, Dutch Cancer Society, Danish Cancer Society, Kom Op Tegen Kanker, Cancerfonden, ALF Region Stockholm, RCC Region Stockholm.

item.title: Addition of irinotecan to chemoradiotherapy as preoperative treatment for locally advanced rectal cancer (ARISTOTLE): a multicentre, open-label, phase 3, randomised controlled trial. / The Lancet Oncology / 2026-07
item.description:

著者

Sebag-Montefiore David, Adams Richard, Gollins Simon, Samuel Leslie M, Glynne-Jones Robert, Harte Robert, West Nicholas, Quirke Philip, Sun Myint Arthur, Bach Simon, Parsons Philip, Dhadda Amandeep Singh, Brown Nicholas, Brown Gina, Harrison Mark, Maggs Rhydian, Begum Rubina, Chang Elizabeth, Hackshaw Allan, Lopes Andre, ARISTOTLE Trial Management Group and Investigators

要旨（訳）

背景：局所進行直腸癌はルーチンに術前放射線療法で治療される。標準的フルオロピリミジンによる同時全身抗癌療法は、一般にアウトカムを改善していない。小規模研究では、イリノテカンおよびフルオロピリミジン化学放射線療法により高い病理学的完全奏効率と許容可能な毒性が報告されている。局所進行直腸癌患者における標準治療化学放射線療法への同時イリノテカン追加の効果を検討することを目的とした。方法：ARISTOTLEは、直腸癌患者を治療する英国75病院施設で実施された多施設共同非盲検並行群間第3相無作為化比較試験である。適格は18歳以上で、MRI定義の局所進行直腸癌が切除断端を脅威または浸潤し、転移がない患者とした。患者は1:1で、術前放射線45 Gyを25分割連日、併用として平日1日2回経口カペシタビン900 mg/m2単独（標準治療群）、または平日1日2回経口カペシタビン650 mg/m2に加え、1〜4週に週1回静注イリノテカン60 mg/m2（イリノテカン群）に無作為割り付けされた。無作為化は中央で実施し、割り付けは研究者に隠蔽された。患者および治療医のマスキングは実行不可能であった。層別化は放射線治療センター、直腸間膜筋膜浸潤、および疑わしい転移性疾患の有無によった。主要エンドポイントは無病生存とし、修正intention-to-treatベース（すなわち、無作為割り付けされた全適格患者）で解析した。安全性解析はプロトコル治療を開始した全患者（as-treated集団）で実施した。イベントまでの時間エンドポイントでは、イベントのない患者は生存が最後に確認された日で打ち切り、欠測の放射線学的および病理学的奏効評価は非奏効として分類した。本試験はEudraCT 2008-005782-59に登録され、完了している。所見：2011年10月25日から2018年7月5日までに589例が治療に無作為割り付けされ、除外後、564例が修正intention-to-treat集団に含まれた（標準治療群284例、イリノテカン群280例）。370例（66%）が男性、194例（34%）が女性、年齢中央値は61歳（IQR 54-68）であった。民族データは収集されなかった。両群の病期は類似していた：標準治療群223例（79%）、イリノテカン群212例（76%）がmrT3腫瘍、それぞれ44例（15%）および45例（16%）がmrT4腫瘍であった。イリノテカン群は標準治療群より45 Gy放射線を受ける割合が低く（276例中208例［75%］対283例中251例［89%］）、計画カペシタビン用量の少なくとも90%を受ける割合も低かった（276例中187例［68%］対283例中253例［89%］）。追跡期間中央値78か月（95% CI 75-86）で、36か月無病生存はイリノテカン群68%（95% CI 63-73）、標準治療群67%（61-72）であった（ハザード比0.91［95% CI 0.68-1.23］；p=0.54）。死亡はイリノテカン群88例（31%）、標準治療群92例（32%）に発生し、直腸癌が主因で、イリノテカン群59例（67%）、標準治療群67例（73%）であった。プロトコル治療関連死亡は5例：イリノテカン群3例（血栓塞栓イベント2例、多臓器不全＋敗血症1例）、標準治療群2例（心停止1例、発熱性好中球減少1例）。Grade 3以上はイリノテカンを受けた患者で標準治療より頻度が高く（215例［78%］対148例［52%］）、血液学的検査（235例［85%］対109例［39%］）および消化管イベント（57例［21%］対35例［12%］）を含み、特に下痢（38例［14%］対10例［4%］）、リンパ球数減少（181例［66%］対100例［35%］）、好中球数減少（27例［10%］対3例［1%］）が顕著であった。解釈：MRI定義の高リスク局所進行直腸癌において、標準治療へのイリノテカン追加はアウトカムを改善せず、放射線療法＋カペシタビンとの併用で使用すべきではない。資金：Cancer Research UK。

Abstract (original)

BACKGROUND: Locally advanced rectal cancer is routinely treated with neoadjuvant radiotherapy. Concomitant systemic anticancer therapy with standard fluoropyrimidines has not generally improved outcomes. Small studies reported high pathological complete response rates and acceptable toxicity using irinotecan and fluoropyrimidine chemoradiation. We aimed to explore the effect of the addition of concomitant irinotecan to standard-of-care chemoradiotherapy in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer. METHODS: ARISTOTLE is a multicentre, open-label, parallel-design, phase 3, randomised controlled trial conducted at 75 UK hospital sites treating patients with rectal cancer. Patients were eligible if they were aged at least 18 years with MRI-defined, locally advanced rectal cancer threatening or involving resection margins without metastases. Patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to preoperative radiotherapy 45 Gy in 25 daily fractions, combined with either oral capecitabine 900 mg/m2 alone twice daily on weekdays (standard-of-care group) or oral capecitabine 650 mg/m2 twice daily on weekdays plus intravenous irinotecan 60 mg/m2 once weekly in weeks 1-4 (irinotecan group). Randomisation was done centrally, with allocation concealed to investigators; masking of patients and treating clinicians was not feasible. Stratification was by radiotherapy centre, mesorectal fascia involvement, and presence or absence of equivocal metastatic disease. The primary endpoint was disease-free survival, with analysis done on a modified intention-to-treat basis (ie, all eligible patients who were randomly assigned to treatment). Safety analyses were conducted in all patients who started protocol treatment (as-treated population). For time-to-event endpoints, patients without an event were censored at the date they were last known to be alive; missing radiological and pathological response assessments were classified as non-response. The study is registered with EudraCT, 2008-005782-59, and is complete. FINDINGS: Between Oct 25, 2011, and July 5, 2018, 589 patients were randomly assigned to treatment; after exclusions, 564 were included in the modified intention-to-treat population (284 in the standard-of-care group and 280 in the irinotecan group). 370 (66%) patients were male, 194 (34%) were female, and median age was 61 years (IQR 54-68); ethnicity data were not collected. Staging in both groups was similar: 223 (79%) patients in the standard-of-care group and 212 (76%) in the irinotecan group had mrT3 tumours; 44 (15%) and 45 (16%) had mrT4 tumours, respectively. Patients in the irinotecan group were less likely to receive 45 Gy radiotherapy than in the standard-of-care group (208 [75%] of 276 vs 251 [89%] of 283) or at least 90% of the planned capecitabine dose (187 [68%] of 276 vs 253 [89%] of 283). With a median follow-up was 78 months (95% CI 75-86), 36-month disease-free survival was 68% (95% CI 63-73) in the irinotecan group versus 67% (61-72) in the standard-of-care group (hazard ratio 0·91 [95% CI 0·68-1·23]; p=0·54). Deaths occurred in 88 (31%) patients in the irinotecan group and 92 (32%) in the standard-of-care group; rectal cancer was the leading cause, occurring in 59 (67%) patients in the irinotecan group and 67 (73%) in the standard-of-care group. There were five deaths related to protocol treatment: three in the irinotecan group (two had a thromboembolic event and one had multiorgan failure plus sepsis) and two in the standard-of-care group (one cardiac arrest and one febrile neutropenia). Grade 3 or worse were more frequent in patients receiving irinotecan than those receiving standard of care (215 [78%] vs 148 [52%]), including haematological investigations (235 [85%] vs 109 [39%]) and gastrointestinal events (57 [21%] vs 35 [12%]), notably diarrhoea (38 [14%] vs ten [4%]), lymphocyte count decreased (181 [66%] vs 100 [35%]), and neutrophil count decreased (27 [10%] vs three [1%]). INTERPRETATION: For MRI-defined, high-risk, locally advanced rectal cancer, the addition of irinotecan to standard of care did not improve outcomes and should not be used in combination with radiotherapy plus capecitabine. FUNDING: Cancer Research UK.

DOI: 10.1016/s1470-2045(26)00132-4 · PMID: 42508427

要旨（訳）

背景：減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法（HIPEC）は、胃癌腹膜転移患者に広く用いられている。しかし、本治療の有効性は全身療法と比較されたことがない。胃癌で限局性腹膜転移を有する患者に対する胃切除＋減量手術＋HIPECの有効性を、全身療法単独と比較することを目的とした。方法：本欧州多施設共同無作為化比較第3相試験（PERISCOPE II）は8つの欧州三次紹介病院で実施し、全身療法3サイクル以上後に病勢進行がなく、切除可能なcT3またはcT4a胃腺癌で限局性腹膜転移（Peritoneal Cancer Index <7）または腫瘍陽性腹膜細胞診、あるいはその両方を有する成人（18歳以上）を登録した。参加者は1:1で標準群（全身療法継続）または実験群（胃切除＋減量手術＋HIPEC、オキサリプラチン［460 mg/m2、41°C］およびドセタキセル［50 mg/m2、37°C］）に無作為割り付けし、施設、組織学的サブタイプ、腹膜転移の程度で層別した。主要エンドポイントは全生存とし、intention-to-treat原則に従い算出した。本試験はClinicalTrials.gov（NCT03348150）に登録され、無益性に関する予定外中間解析により早期終了した。所見：2017年11月6日から2024年8月21日までに102例を登録した（各群51例）。年齢中央値は60歳（IQR 51-69）、男性58例（57%）、女性43例（43%）、白人86例（85%）であった。追跡期間中央値は67か月（IQR 47-73）。標準群の全生存中央値は16.6か月（95% CI 14.1-21.9）、実験群は15.7か月（11.4-25.5）であった（ハザード比1.10［95% CI 0.69-1.74］；p=0.70）。Grade 3以上の有害事象は標準群51例中10例（20%）、実験群50例中21例（42%）に認められた。最も頻度の高いGrade 3以上の有害事象は、実験群では貧血（4例［8%］）および肝酵素上昇（4例［8%］）、標準群では悪心（2例［4%］）、肝酵素上昇（2例［4%］）、電解質異常（2例［4%］）であった。重篤な有害事象は標準群51例中3例（6%）、実験群50例中22例（44%）に認められた。無作為化後100日時点で、治療関連死亡は3例発生し、すべて実験群で、急性呼吸窮迫症候群（1例）、吻合部漏出（1例）、出血（1例）に帰属された。解釈：胃癌で限局性腹膜転移を有する患者において、胃切除＋減量手術＋HIPECは全身療法単独と比較して生存利益を示さなかった。資金：Dutch Cancer Society、Netherlands Organisation for Health Research and Development、Dutch Ministry of Health、Henk Boot、Bengt Ihre Research Foundation、Swedish Cancer Society。

Abstract (original)

BACKGROUND: Cytoreductive surgery with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) is widely used for patients with gastric cancer and peritoneal metastases. However, the efficacy of this treatment has never been compared with that of systemic therapy. We aimed to investigate the efficacy of gastrectomy with cytoreductive surgery and HIPEC for patients with gastric cancer and limited peritoneal metastases, compared with systemic therapy alone. METHODS: In this European, multicentre, randomised, controlled, phase 3 trial (PERISCOPE II) in eight European tertiary referral hospitals, we recruited adults (aged ≥18 years) with resectable cT3 or cT4a gastric adenocarcinoma who had limited peritoneal metastases (Peritoneal Cancer Index <7) or tumour-positive peritoneal cytology, or both, in the absence of disease progression after three or more cycles of systemic therapy. Participants were randomly allocated (1:1) to the standard group (continuation of systemic therapy) or the experimental group (gastrectomy plus cytoreductive surgery and HIPEC with oxaliplatin [460 mg/m2 at 41°C] and docetaxel [50 mg/m2 at 37°C]), stratified by centre, histological subtype, and extent of peritoneal metastases. The primary endpoint was overall survival, calculated following the intention-to-treat principle. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT03348150, and was closed prematurely due to an unplanned interim analysis for futility. FINDINGS: Between Nov 6, 2017 and Aug 21, 2024, 102 participants were recruited (51 per group). Median age was 60 years (IQR 51-69); 58 (57%) participants were men, 43 (43%) were women, and 86 (85%) were White. Median follow-up was 67 months (IQR 47-73). Median overall survival in the standard group was 16·6 months (95% CI 14·1-21·9), compared with 15·7 months (11·4-25·5) in the experimental group (hazard ratio 1·10 [95% CI 0·69-1·74]; p=0·70). Ten (20%) of 51 patients in the standard group and 21 (42%) of 50 patients in the experimental group had grade 3 or worse adverse events. The most common grade 3 or worse adverse events were anaemia (four [8%] patients) and elevated liver enzymes (four [8%]) in the experimental group, and nausea (two [4%]), elevated liver enzymes (two [4%]), and electrolyte disturbances (two [4%]) in the standard group. Three (6%) of 51 patients in the standard group and 22 (44%) of 50 patients in the experimental group had serious adverse events. At 100 days after randomisation, three treatment-related deaths had occurred, all in the experimental group and attributed to acute respiratory distress syndrome (one patient), anastomotic leakage (one patient), and bleeding (one patient). INTERPRETATION: Gastrectomy with cytoreductive surgery and HIPEC provided no survival benefit in patients with gastric cancer and limited peritoneal metastases compared with systemic therapy alone. FUNDING: The Dutch Cancer Society, the Netherlands Organisation for Health Research and Development, the Dutch Ministry of Health, Henk Boot, the Bengt Ihre Research Foundation, and the Swedish Cancer Society.

要旨（訳）

背景：術前免疫チェックポイント阻害は、ミスマッチ修復欠損（dMMR）またはマイクロサテライト不安定性高（MSI-H）、局所進行大腸癌で顕著な活性を示している。前臨床研究は、COX-2阻害が炎症性腫瘍微小環境を調節し、PD-1阻害の効果を増強しうることを示唆する。本集団において、術前トリパリマブへのCOX-2阻害薬セレコキシブの追加が病理学的完全奏効を増加させるかを検討することを目的とした。方法：PICC-2は中国の3学術病院で実施された多施設、非盲検、無作為化、対照、第2相試験であった。適格患者は18–75歳；組織学的に確認されたdMMRまたはMSI-H大腸癌で、臨床病期T3–T4またはリンパ節陽性（N+）を伴う任意の臨床T病期；Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance statusスコア0または1；十分な血液学的、肝、腎機能を有した。参加者はインタラクティブウェブ応答システムにより、腫瘍部位および臨床T病期で層別化し、術前トリパリマブ＋セレコキシブまたはトリパリマブ単剤療法を14日ごとに12サイクル施行後に手術を受けるよう1:1で無作為割り付けされた。トリパリマブ3 mg/kgは両群で1日目に静脈内投与され、トリパリマブ＋セレコキシブ群の患者はセレコキシブ200 mgを1–14日目に1日2回経口投与も受けた。主要評価項目は病理学的完全奏効を達成した患者の割合であり、手術時に原発腫瘍および全採取リンパ節に残存生存腫瘍がないことと定義し、intention-to-treat集団で中央盲検独立病理レビューにより評価した。安全性は試験治療を少なくとも1回受けた全患者で評価した。本試験はClinicalTrials.gov、NCT03926338に登録され、進行中である。所見：2022年5月5日から2025年1月20日までに110例がトリパリマブ＋セレコキシブ（n=55）またはトリパリマブ単剤療法（n=55）に無作為割り付けされた。全体として、65例（59%）が男性、全患者が中国人、76例（69%）がcT4腫瘍、105例（95%）が臨床的リンパ節陽性であった。データカットオフ日（2025年10月10日）時点で、追跡期間中央値は18.1か月（IQR 11.5–25.3）であった。各群55例中49例（89%）が計画された術前療法12サイクルすべてを完了した。手術はトリパリマブ＋セレコキシブ群55例中53例（96%）、単剤療法群55例中51例（93%）で施行された。病理学的完全奏効はトリパリマブ＋セレコキシブ群55例中49例（89%［95% CI 78–96］）、単剤療法群55例中38例（69%［55–81］）で観察された（群間差19パーセントポイント［95% CI 4–34］；p=0.014）。グレード3治療関連有害事象はそれぞれ3例（5%）および4例（7%）で発生し、グレード3治療関連有害事象はトリパリマブ＋セレコキシブ群で腫瘍穿孔（2例［4%］）および腸閉塞（1例［2%］）、単剤療法群で発疹（1例［2%］）、腫瘍穿孔（1例［2%］）、アミノトランスフェラーゼ上昇（1例［2%］）、甲状腺機能低下（1例［2%］）であった。グレード4または5治療関連有害事象は発生しなかった。解釈：dMMRまたはMSI-H局所進行大腸癌患者において、術前トリパリマブ＋セレコキシブはトリパリマブ単剤療法と比較して病理学的完全奏効を達成した患者の割合を有意に増加させ、安全性プロファイルは類似していた。これらの所見は、より大規模な第3相試験における本併用戦略のさらなる検討を支持する。資金提供：中国国家自然科学基金、広東基礎・応用基礎研究、中国国家重点臨床学科、広東省消化器疾患臨床研究センタープログラム、中国臨床腫瘍学会–君実生物腫瘍免疫研究。翻訳：抄録の中国語訳は補足資料を参照。

Abstract (original)

BACKGROUND: Neoadjuvant immune checkpoint blockade has shown remarkable activity in mismatch repair-deficient (dMMR) or microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H), locally advanced colorectal cancer. Preclinical studies suggest that COX-2 inhibition might modulate the inflammatory tumour microenvironment and augment the effect of PD-1 blockade. We aimed to investigate whether the addition of the COX-2 inhibitor celecoxib to neoadjuvant toripalimab would increase the pathological complete response in this population. METHODS: PICC-2 was a multicentre, open-label, randomised, controlled, phase 2 trial conducted at three academic hospitals in China. Eligible patients were aged 18-75 years; had histologically confirmed dMMR or MSI-H colorectal cancer, of clinical stage T3-T4 or any clinical T stage with lymph node positivity (N+); had an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status score of 0 or 1; and had adequate haematological, hepatic, and renal function. Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) via an interactive web response system, stratified by tumour location and clinical T stage, to receive neoadjuvant toripalimab plus celecoxib or toripalimab monotherapy every 14 days for 12 cycles, followed by surgery. Toripalimab 3 mg/kg was administered intravenously on day 1 in both groups; patients in the toripalimab plus celecoxib group also received celecoxib 200 mg orally twice daily on days 1-14. The primary endpoint was the proportion of patients with pathological complete response, defined as no presence of residual viable tumour in the primary tumour and all sampled lymph nodes at surgery, assessed by central blinded independent pathological review in the intention-to-treat population. Safety was assessed in all patients who received at least one dose of study treatment. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT03926338, and is ongoing. FINDINGS: Between May 5, 2022, and Jan 20, 2025, 110 patients were randomly assigned to toripalimab plus celecoxib (n=55) or toripalimab monotherapy (n=55). Overall, 65 (59%) patients were male, all patients were Chinese, 76 (69%) had cT4 tumours, and 105 (95%) had clinically node-positive disease. At the data cutoff date (Oct 10, 2025), median follow-up was 18·1 months (IQR 11·5-25·3). 49 (89%) of 55 patients in each group completed all 12 planned cycles of neoadjuvant therapy. Surgery was done in 53 (96%) of 55 patients in the toripalimab plus celecoxib group and 51 (93%) of 55 in the monotherapy group. Pathological complete response was observed in 49 of 55 patients (89% [95% CI 78-96]) in the toripalimab plus celecoxib group versus 38 of 55 (69% [55-81]) in the monotherapy group (between-group difference 19 percentage points [95% CI 4-34]; p=0·014). Grade 3 treatment-related adverse events occurred in three (5%) patients and four (7%) patients, respectively; grade 3 treatment-related adverse events were tumour perforation (two [4%]) and bowel obstruction (one [2%]) in the toripalimab plus celecoxib group, and rash (one [2%]), tumour perforation (one [2%]), increased aminotransferase (one [2%]), and hypothyroidism (one [2%]) in the monotherapy group. No grade 4 or 5 treatment-related adverse events occurred. INTERPRETATION: In patients with dMMR or MSI-H locally advanced colorectal cancer, neoadjuvant toripalimab plus celecoxib significantly increased the proportion of patients attaining pathological complete response compared with toripalimab monotherapy, with a similar safety profile. These findings support further investigation of this combination strategy in larger phase 3 trials. FUNDING: The National Natural Science Foundation of China, Guangdong Basic and Applied Basic Research, the National Key Clinical Discipline of China, the Program of Guangdong Provincial Clinical Research Center for Digestive Diseases, and the Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology-Junshi Biosciences Oncology Immunity Research. TRANSLATION: For the Chinese translation of the abstract see Supplementary Materials section.

DOI: 10.1016/s1470-2045(26)00220-2 · PMID: 42385761

item.title: Perioperative systemic therapy versus surgery alone for resectable colorectal peritoneal-only metastases (CAIRO6): a randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial. / The Lancet Oncology / 2026-06

著者

Rovers Koen P, Bakkers Checca, van den Heuvel Teun B M, van de Vlasakker Vincent C J, Kerkhoff Teun M E, Nienhuijs Simon W, Burger Jacobus W A, Creemers Geert-Jan M, van Hellemond Irene E G, Tuynman Jurriaan B, Kusters Miranda, Buffart Tineke E, Aalbers Arend G J, Kok Niels F M, Chalabi Myriam, Boerma Djamila, Brandt-Kerkhof Alexandra R M, de Reuver Philip R, Hemmer Patrick H J, van Grevenstein Wilhelmina M U, van der Speeten Kurt, Snaebjornsson Petur, Lee-Law Pui Yuen, Lahaye Max J, Nederend Joost, Kranenburg Onno, Bouma Jeanette M, Punt Cornelis J A, Dijkgraaf Marcel G W, Tanis Pieter J, de Hingh Ignace H J T, CAIRO6 Investigators, Dutch Peritoneal Oncology Group and the Dutch Colorectal Cancer Group

要旨（訳）

背景：切除可能な大腸腹膜限局転移患者における周術期全身療法の価値に関するデータは乏しい。本試験は、この集団における周術期全身療法対手術単独の有効性を比較することを目的とした。方法：本無作為化、非盲検、第3相試験は、オランダの全9三次センターおよびベルギーの1三次センターで実施された。適格患者は18歳以上、WHO performance status 0または1、大腸腺癌の病理学的に証明された切除可能な腹膜限局転移を有し、少なくとも6か月間全身療法を受けていなかった。登録患者はウェブベースシステムを用い、既往全身療法、同時性または異時性腹膜転移、腹膜癌指数0–10または11–20、マイトマイシンCベースまたはオキサリプラチンベースHIPECで最小化層別化し、周術期全身療法および減量手術＋腹腔内温熱化学療法（CRS-HIPEC；周術期全身療法群）または先行CRS-HIPEC単独（手術単独群）に1:1で無作為割り付けされた。治験責任医師の選択により、周術期全身療法は、CAPOXの3週サイクル4回の術前および術後（静脈内オキサリプラチン130 mg/m²に続き、経口カペシタビン1,000 mg/m²を1–14日目に1日2回）、FOLFOXの2週サイクル6回の術前および術後（静脈内オキサリプラチン85 mg/m²と静脈内ロイコボリン400 mg/m²に続き、急速静注5-フルオロウラシル400 mg/m²、および48時間持続静注5-フルオロウラシル2,400 mg/m²）、またはFOLFIRIの2週サイクル6回の術前（静脈内イリノテカン180 mg/m²と静脈内ロイコボリン400 mg/m²に続き、急速静注5-フルオロウラシル400 mg/m²、および48時間持続静注5-フルオロウラシル2,400 mg/m²）に続く、経口カペシタビンの3週サイクル4回の術後（1,000 mg/m²を1–14日目に1日2回）または5-フルオロウラシルおよびロイコボリンの2週サイクル6回の術後（静脈内ロイコボリン400 mg/m²に続き、急速静注5-フルオロウラシル400 mg/m²、および48時間持続静注5-フルオロウラシル2,400 mg/m²）のいずれかであった。静脈内ベバシズマブはCAPOXの最初の3術前サイクル（7.5 mg/kg）またはFOLFOXもしくはFOLFIRIの最初の4術前サイクル（5 mg/kg）に追加された。主要転帰は、治療前に同意を撤回した患者または主要な適格基準に違反した患者を除外した事前規定修正intention-to-treat集団で評価した全生存であった。主要な術後合併症はClavien-Dindoグレード3–5と定義し、術後90日まで評価した。主要な全身療法関連毒性はCommon Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events（CTCAE）グレード3–5と定義し、最終投与後30日まで評価した。オランダの大腸癌患者団体が試験デザインに関与した。本試験はClinicaltrials.gov（NCT02758951）に登録され、登録は終了しているが活動中である。所見：2017年6月15日から2024年4月29日までに1,922例が適格性についてスクリーニングされた。このうち358例が登録され、周術期全身療法（n=180）または手術単独（n=178）に無作為割り付けされた。351例が修正intention-to-treat集団に含まれた（周術期全身療法に無作為割り付けされた173例および手術単独の178例；男性181例［52%］、女性170例［48%］）。追跡期間中央値41か月（IQR 21–62）後、全生存中央値は周術期全身療法群で44か月（95% CI 30–54）、手術単独群で39か月（95% CI 31–46）であった（ハザード比［HR］0.85、95% CI 0.62–1.15；p=0.28）。肉眼的完全またはほぼ完全CRS-HIPECを受けた292例において、主要な90日術後合併症は周術期全身療法群138例中49例（36%）、手術単独群154例中40例（26%）で発生した。最も頻度の高いClavien-Dindoグレード3–4術後有害事象は腹腔内膿瘍（周術期全身療法群138例中16例［12%］対手術単独群154例中16例［10%］）、吻合部漏出（12例［9%］対6例［4%］）、筋膜離開（13例［9%］対6例［4%］）であった。90日術後死亡は周術期全身療法群2例（1%）（吻合部漏出および脳血管事故）、手術単独群1例（1%）（吻合部漏出）で発生した。主要な全身療法関連毒性は、周術期全身療法を開始した161例中92例（57%）で発生した。最も頻度の高いCTCAEグレード3–4全身療法関連有害事象は高血圧（13例［8%］）、下痢（12例［7%］）、好中球減少（11例［7%］）、血栓塞栓事象（10例［6%］）であった。全身療法関連死亡は1例（1%）（高血糖）で発生した。解釈：切除可能な大腸腹膜限局転移の全患者に周術期全身療法を推奨することはできない。資金提供：Dutch Cancer Society、F Hoffman-La Roche。

Abstract (original)

BACKGROUND: Data are sparse on the value of perioperative systemic therapy in patients with resectable colorectal peritoneal-only metastases. This trial aimed to compare the efficacy of perioperative systemic therapy versus surgery alone in this population. METHODS: This randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial was done at all nine Dutch tertiary centres and one Belgian tertiary centre. Eligible patients were aged 18 years or older with a WHO performance status of 0 or 1 and pathologically proven resectable peritoneal-only metastases of a colorectal adenocarcinoma who did not receive systemic therapy for at least 6 months. Enrolled patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to perioperative systemic therapy and cytoreductive surgery with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (CRS-HIPEC; perioperative systemic therapy group) or upfront CRS-HIPEC alone (surgery alone group) using a web-based system with minimisation stratified by previous systemic therapy, synchronous or metachronous peritoneal metastases, peritoneal cancer index 0-10 or 11-20, and mitomycin C-based or oxaliplatin-based HIPEC. At investigator's choice, perioperative systemic therapy comprised either four 3-week neoadjuvant and adjuvant cycles of CAPOX (intravenous oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2 followed by oral capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 twice per day on days 1-14), six 2-week neoadjuvant and adjuvant cycles of FOLFOX (intravenous oxaliplatin 85 mg/m2 with intravenous leucovorin 400 mg/m2, followed by bolus intravenous 5-fluorouracil 400 mg/m2, and continuous intravenous 5-fluorouracil 2400 mg/m2 for 48 h), or six 2-week neoadjuvant cycles of FOLFIRI (intravenous irinotecan 180 mg/m2 with intravenous leucovorin 400 mg/m2, followed by bolus intravenous 5-fluorouracil 400 mg/m2, and continuous intravenous 5-fluorouracil 2400 mg/m2 for 48 h) followed by either four 3-week adjuvant cycles of oral capecitabine (1000 mg/m2 twice per day on days 1-14) or six 2-week adjuvant cycles of 5-fluorouracil and leucovorin (intravenous leucovorin 400 mg/m2, followed by bolus intravenous 5-fluorouracil 400 mg/m2, and continuous intravenous 5-fluorouracil 2400 mg/m2 for 48 h). Intravenous bevacizumab was added to the first three neoadjuvant cycles of CAPOX (7·5 mg/kg) or the first four neoadjuvant cycles of FOLFOX or FOLFIRI (5 mg/kg). The primary outcome was overall survival assessed in a prespecified modified intention-to-treat population, excluding patients who withdrew consent before treatment or violated major eligibility criteria. Major postoperative morbidity was defined as Clavien-Dindo grade 3-5 and assessed up to 90 days postoperatively. Major systemic therapy-related toxicity was defined as Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) grade 3-5 and assessed up to 30 days after its last administration. The Dutch patient organisation for colorectal cancer was involved in the trial design. The trial is registered with Clinicaltrials.gov (NCT02758951) and is active but not recruiting. FINDINGS: Between June 15, 2017, and April 29, 2024, 1922 patients were screened for eligibility. Of these, 358 patients were enrolled and randomly assigned to perioperative systemic therapy (n=180) or surgery alone (n=178). 351 patients were included in the modified intention-to-treat population (173 patients randomly assigned to perioperative systemic therapy and 178 patients to surgery alone; 181 [52%] male and 170 [48%] female). After a median follow-up of 41 months (IQR 21-62), median overall survival was 44 months (95% CI 30-54) in the perioperative systemic therapy group versus 39 months (95% CI 31-46) in the surgery alone group (hazard ratio [HR] 0·85, 95% CI 0·62-1·15; p=0·28). In 292 patients who underwent macroscopic complete or near complete CRS-HIPEC, major 90-day postoperative morbidity occurred in 49 (36%) of 138 patients in the perioperative systemic therapy group and in 40 (26%) of 154 patients in the surgery alone group. The most common Clavien-Dindo grade 3-4 postoperative adverse events were intra-abdominal abscess (16 [12%] of 138 patients in the perioperative systemic therapy group vs 16 [10%] of 154 patients in the surgery alone group), anastomotic leakage (12 [9%] vs six [4%]), and fascia dehiscence (13 [9%] vs six [4%]). 90-day postoperative mortality occurred in two (1%) patients in the perioperative systemic therapy group (anastomotic leakage and cerebrovascular accident) and in one (1%) patient in the surgery alone group (anastomotic leakage). Major systemic therapy-related toxicity occurred in 92 (57%) of 161 patients who started perioperative systemic therapy. The most common CTCAE grade 3-4 systemic therapy-related adverse events were hypertension (13 [8%] patients), diarrhoea (12 [7%] patients), neutropenia (11 [7%] patients), and thromboembolic events (ten [6%] patients). Systemic therapy-related death occurred in one (1%) patient (hyperglycaemia). INTERPRETATION: Perioperative systemic therapy cannot be recommended in all patients with resectable colorectal peritoneal-only metastases. FUNDING: Dutch Cancer Society, F Hoffman-La Roche.

DOI: 10.1016/s1470-2045(26)00085-9 · PMID: 42372745

  • Westmead Hospital — オーストラリア

要旨（訳）

背景：MRIは臨床的に有意な前立腺癌が疑われる男性に推奨される。臨床的高リスクであるが非疑わしいまたは判定困難なMRIを有する者はしばしば前立腺生検を受けるが、臨床的に有意な前立腺癌の可能性は低く、臨床的に非有意な前立腺癌の発生率は高い。ガリウム-68（[⁶⁸Ga]Ga）-前立腺特異的膜抗原（PSMA）-11 PET-CTが、臨床的に有意な前立腺癌診断を損なうことなく、前立腺生検を要する人数を減らし、生検を標的コアに限定しうるかを検討することを目的とした。方法：オーストラリア7病院で実施された本多施設、非劣性、第3相、無作為化比較試験では、臨床的に有意な前立腺癌が疑われ、判定困難（Prostate Imaging-Reporting and Data System［PI-RADS］3）または非疑わしい（PI-RADS 2）MRIであるが臨床的高リスク（例：前立腺特異抗原［PSA］密度>0.1 ng/mL/mL、強い前立腺癌家族歴、異常直腸診、BRCA変異、PSA>10 ng/mL、PSA倍加時間<36か月、またはPSA速度>0.75 ng/mL/年）、PSA 20 ng/mL以下、臨床T2以下の生検未施行参加者を募集した。参加者は中央ウェブベースシステムを用い、ブロックサイズ2または4および試験施設による層別化で、[⁶⁸Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT（実験群）または系統的経会陰前立腺生検（対照群）に1:1で無作為割り付けされた。参加者および治験責任医師にマスキングはなかった。陽性[⁶⁸Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT（PRIMARYスコア3–5）の参加者はPSMA-PET標的経会陰前立腺生検を受け、陰性結果（PRIMARYスコア1–2）の者は生検を回避した。共同主要転帰は、Gleasonスコア3+4（パターン4≥10%）以上と定義された臨床的に有意な前立腺癌を有する参加者の割合、および無作為割り付け後6か月以内に生検を回避した[⁶⁸Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT群の参加者の割合であった。二項モデルに基づく両側95% Wald CIを用い、臨床的に有意な前立腺癌を有する参加者の割合のリスク差を推定し（非劣性マージン10%）、無作為割り付け6か月後に生検を回避した実験群参加者の割合を推定した（20%閾値）。intention-to-treatに基づき解析した。本試験はClinicalTrials.gov、NCT05154162に登録され、参加者追跡は進行中である。所見：2022年3月2日から2025年8月24日までに適格男性参加者660例が登録され、年齢中央値61歳（IQR 56–66）、PSA中央値5.2 ng/mL（4.0–7.0）、PSA密度中央値0.13 ng/mL/mL（0.09–0.17）であった。PI-RADS 2は335例（51%）、PI-RADS 3は325例（49%）であった。民族データは収集されなかった。329例（50%）が系統的経会陰前立腺生検の対照群に、331例（50%）が[⁶⁸Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CTの実験群に割り付けられた。実験群における臨床的に有意な前立腺癌を有する参加者の割合（331例中39例［12%］）は対照（329例中51例［16%］；差−3.7%［95% CI −8.9から1.5%］；p=0.0093）に非劣性であった。[⁶⁸Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CTの使用により331例中163例（49%）で生検が回避された（95% CI 44から55%；p<0.0001）。前立腺生検後、参加者は疼痛（実験群33例［21%］対対照群62例［21%］）、血尿（60例［38%］対126例［43%］）、血精液症（77例［48%］対133例［45%］）の類似した割合を報告した。解釈：[⁶⁸Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CTは、臨床的高リスクであるが非疑わしいまたは判定困難な前立腺MRIを有する患者の診断経路を改善する可能性を有しうる。健康経済解析および他のPSMA放射性医薬品での検証を含むさらなる研究が、本アプローチの臨床実装および一般化可能性を確認するために必要である。資金提供：Prostate Cancer Foundation、National Health and Medical Research Council、St Vincent's Curran Foundation、Peter MacCallum Cancer Foundation。

Abstract (original)

BACKGROUND: MRI is recommended for men with clinical suspicion of significant prostate cancer. Those with high clinical risk but non-suspicious or equivocal MRI often undergo prostate biopsy, but have a low likelihood of clinically significant prostate cancer, and a high incidence of clinically insignificant prostate cancer. We aimed to investigate whether gallium-68 ([68Ga]Ga)-prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-11 PET-CT could reduce the number of people requiring prostate biopsy and limit biopsy to targeted cores, without compromising clinically significant prostate cancer diagnosis. METHODS: In this multicentre, non-inferiority, phase 3, randomised controlled trial, done at at seven Australian hospitals, we recruited biopsy-naive participants with clinical suspicion of significant prostate cancer, equivocal (Prostate Imaging-Reporting and Data System [PI-RADS] 3) or non-suspicious (PI-RADS 2) MRI but high clinical risk (eg, prostate-specific antigen [PSA] density of >0·1 ng/mL/mL, strong family history of prostate cancer, abnormal digital rectal examination, BRCA mutation, PSA >10 ng/mL, PSA doubling time <36 months, or PSA velocity >0·75 ng/mL per year), PSA of 20 ng/mL or less, and clinical T2 disease or less. Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) using a centralised web-based system to undergo [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT (experimental group) or systematic transperineal prostate biopsy (control group), using block sizes of two or four and stratification by study site. There was no masking for participants or investigators. Participants with positive [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT (PRIMARY score 3-5) underwent PSMA-PET-targeted transperineal prostate biopsies, whereas those with a negative result (PRIMARY score 1-2) avoided biopsy. The co-primary outcomes were the proportion of participants with clinically significant prostate cancer, defined as a Gleason score of 3 + 4 (≥10% pattern 4) or higher, and the proportion of participants in the [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT group who avoided biopsy within 6 months of random assignment. A two-sided 95% Wald CI based on a binomial model was used to estimate the risk difference in the proportion of participants with clinically significant prostate cancer (non-inferiority margin 10%) and to estimate the proportion of participants in the experimental group who had avoided biopsy 6 months after random assignment (20% threshold), analysed based on intention to treat. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05154162, and participant follow-up is ongoing. FINDINGS: Between March 2, 2022, and Aug 24, 2025, 660 eligible male participants were enrolled and had a median age of 61 years (IQR 56-66), a median PSA of 5·2 ng/mL (4·0-7·0), and a median PSA density of 0·13 ng/mL/mL (0·09-0·17). There were PI-RADS 2 in 335 (51%) participants and PI-RADS 3 in 325 (49%) participants. Ethnicity data were not collected. 329 (50%) were assigned to the control group with systematic transperineal prostate biopsy, and 331 (50%) were assigned to the experimental group with [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT. The proportion of participants with clinically significant prostate cancer in the experimental group (39 [12%] of 331) was non-inferior to the control (51 [16%] of 329; difference -3·7% [95% CI -8·9 to 1·5%]; p=0·0093). Use of [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT avoided biopsy in 163 (49%) of 331 participants (95% CI 44 to 55%; p <0·0001). After prostate biopsy, participants reported similar proportions of pain (33 [21%] in the experimental group vs 62 [21%] in the control group), haematuria (60 [38%] vs 126 [43%]), and haematospermia (77 [48%] vs 133 [45%]). INTERPRETATION: [68Ga]Ga-PSMA-11 PET-CT could have the potential to improve the diagnostic pathway of patients with a high clinical risk but non-suspicious or equivocal prostate MRI. Further research, including health-economic analyses and validation with other PSMA radiopharmaceuticals, are needed to confirm the clinical implementation and generalisability of this approach. FUNDING: Prostate Cancer Foundation, National Health and Medical Research Council, St Vincent's Curran Foundation, and Peter MacCallum Cancer Foundation.

DOI: 10.1016/s1470-2045(26)00120-8 · PMID: 42269655

item.title: Quality, Cost, and Timeliness of Cancer Treatment in Medicare Advantage and Traditional Medicare. / JAMA Internal Medicine / 2026-07

掲載誌

ISSN 2168-6106 · IF 2025 26.3

著者

Mitchell Aaron P, Dusetzina Stacie B, Mishra Meza Akriti, Gallagher Grace, Augello Patrick, Fuchs Hannah, Guzman Gabrielle, Abdelaziz Abdullah, Tabatabai Sara, Persaud Sonia, Chakraborty Nirjhar, Blinder Victoria S, Epstein Andrew S, Daly Bobby, Wood William A, Winn Aaron N, Gönen Mithat, Jung Jeah

所属・国

  • Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center — アメリカ
  • Vanderbilt University Medical Center — アメリカ
  • University of Illinois Chicago — アメリカ
  • University of Chicago — アメリカ
  • University of Pittsburgh — アメリカ
  • University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill — アメリカ
  • George Mason University — アメリカ

要旨（訳）

重要性：Medicare Advantage（MA）保険の利用は、従来型Medicare（TM）と比較して癌治療費の低下と関連してきた。MAとTMで保険加入した受益者において、ガイドライン準拠ケアまたは治療費に差があるかは不明である。目的：Medicare保険の種類が至適癌治療の実施および費用と関連するかを評価する。デザイン、設定、対象：2015年から2019年のMedicare請求およびエンカウンターデータを用いた集団ベース標本の後ろ向きコホート研究。対象はMAまたはTMに継続加入し、2016年から2019年に新規癌診断を受けたMedicare受益者とした。推奨治療選択肢の費用に実質的なばらつきがある癌治療シナリオ（例：転移性メラノーマ、III期結腸癌の術後補助療法）を有する患者を含めた。データ解析は2025年4月から2026年3月に実施した。曝露：MAまたはTMのMedicare保険の種類。主要評価項目：各患者が開始した利用可能な選択肢のうちの薬理学的癌治療をMedicareデータで解析した。各患者の治療を診断日で当時のNational Comprehensive Cancer Network Guidelines推奨およびMedicare償還率に紐づけ、癌種に対する至適治療を受けたか、および開始した治療の予想費用という共同主要アウトカムを判定した。アウトカムと保険種類の関連は、逆確率治療重み付けにより患者特性をバランスさせた後、一般化推定方程式を用いてリスク比（RR）を推定した。モデルは医師レベルでクラスタ化し、シナリオ、診断年、シナリオ×診断年交互作用、腫瘍医特性で調整した。結果：35,245例（年齢中央値74歳［IQR 70-79］；男性63.2%）のうち、24,269例がTM、10,976例がMAであった。治療開始までの期間中央値はMAで36日（IQR 20-60）、TMで35日（IQR 19-59）であった。未調整の治療費平均（SD）はMAで29,252ドル（80,391ドル）、TMで40,874ドル（106,205ドル）であった。MA受益者の至適治療実施の尤度はTM受益者と同程度であり（調整RR 0.99；95% CI, 0.97-1.02）、MAは治療費低下と関連した（調整費用比0.94；95% CI, 0.91-0.97）。本患者コホート内の平均節約額は−931ドル（95% CI, −1,244〜−615）であった。結論および意義：癌を有するMedicare受益者の本コホート研究では、MA受益者はTM受益者と比較して推定治療費が低く、至適治療を受ける尤度は同程度であった。

Abstract (original)

IMPORTANCE: Use of Medicare Advantage (MA) insurance has been associated with lower cancer treatment costs than traditional Medicare (TM). Whether there are differences in guideline-concordant care or treatment costs for beneficiaries insured under MA vs TM is unknown. OBJECTIVE: To assess whether Medicare insurance type is associated with receipt of optimal cancer treatment and costs. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: Retrospective cohort study of a population-based sample using Medicare claims and encounter data from 2015 through 2019. Participants were Medicare beneficiaries with continuous enrollment in either MA or TM and an incident cancer diagnosis from 2016 through 2019. Included patients were those with cancer treatment scenarios (eg, metastatic melanoma, adjuvant therapy for stage III colon cancer) that had substantial variation in the costs of recommended treatment options. Data were analyzed from April 2025 to March 2026. EXPOSURES: Medicare insurance type of MA or TM. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The pharmacologic cancer treatment among the available options each patient initiated was analyzed using Medicare data. Each patient's treatment was linked by diagnosis date to contemporary National Comprehensive Cancer Network Guidelines recommendations and Medicare reimbursement rates to ascertain the coprimary outcomes whether a patient received the optimal treatment for their cancer type and the anticipated cost of the initiated treatment. The association of outcomes with insurance type was accessed using generalized estimating equations to estimate risk ratios (RRs) after balancing patient characteristics through inverse probability-of-treatment weighting. Models were clustered at the physician level and adjusted for scenario, diagnosis year, scenario × diagnosis year interaction, and oncologist characteristics. RESULTS: Of 35 245 patients (median age, 74 [IQR 70-79] years; 63.2% male), 24 269 had TM and 10 976 had MA. The median time to treatment initiation was 36 (IQR, 20-60) days for MA vs 35 (IQR, 19-59) days for TM. The unadjusted mean (SD) treatment cost was $29 252 ($80 391) for MA vs $40 874 ($106 205) for TM. MA beneficiaries had a likelihood of optimal treatment similar to TM beneficiaries (adjusted RR, 0.99; 95% CI, 0.97-1.02), and MA was associated with lower treatment cost (adjusted cost ratio, 0.94; 95% CI, 0.91- 0.97). Mean savings within this patient cohort was -$931 (95% CI, -$1244 to -$615). CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study of Medicare beneficiaries with cancer, MA beneficiaries had lower estimated treatment costs and similar likelihood of receiving optimal treatment compared with TM beneficiaries.

DOI: 10.1001/jamainternmed.2026.2864 · PMID: 42440324

item.title: Cancer Biologics Utilization After Biosimilar Entry and Financial Implications For Payers and Patients. / JAMA Oncology / 2026-08
item.description:
掲載誌

JAMA Oncology (2026-08-27) · 優先誌

ISSN 2374-2437 · IF 2025 23.9

著者

Liu Xiaoyu, Xu Xiaoyi, Lu Z John, Shih Ya-Chen Tina

所属・国

  • University of California, Los Angeles — アメリカ
  • USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center — アメリカ

要旨（訳）

重要性：バイオシミラーは先行バイオロジクスと高度に類似しており、市場競争の増加、バイオロジクス価格の低下、経済的負担の軽減による患者アクセス拡大を目的として導入された。2024年末までに、3つの抗がんバイオロジクス（bevacizumab、rituximab、trastuzumab）が米国でバイオシミラー参入を経験しており、支払者および患者に対する財政的影響の評価が必要である。目的：bevacizumab、rituximab、またはtrastuzumabを受けた患者におけるバイオシミラー使用パターンに関連する市場動態および財政的影響を評価する。デザイン、設定、対象：本後ろ向きコホートは、バイオシミラー参入後の価格および市場シェアの動向、ならびに支払者および患者コストを検討した。2019年7月から2024年12月までのMerative MarketScan商業データベースおよびMedicareデータベースのデータを用いた。治療開始後12か月以内の使用パターンに基づき、患者を4群に分類した：バイオシミラーのみ使用、参照製品（すなわち先行バイオロジクス）のみ使用、参照製品からバイオシミラーへ切替、バイオシミラーから参照製品へ切替。データは2025年9月から2026年3月に解析した。主要評価項目および測定：主要研究評価項目は、平均販売価格（ASP）、参照製品の市場シェア、研究期間内の月あたり平均支払者コストおよび自己負担コストであった。結果：本研究の1万4655例のうち、平均（SD）年齢は57（13）歳、女性9985例（68.1%）、最も多いがんは乳がん（5182例［35.4%］）、リンパ腫（4320例［29.5%］）、大腸がん（1998例［13.6%］）であった。8710例（59.4%）がバイオシミラーのみ使用、4760例（32.5%）が参照製品のみ使用、1015例（6.9%）が参照製品からバイオシミラーへ切替、170例（1.2%）がバイオシミラーから参照製品へ切替であった。バイオシミラー参入後、3つの参照製品のASPは年平均3.8%低下した。市場シェアは民間保険で年30%、Medicare Part B市場で31.5%低下した。参照製品のみ使用した患者と比較して、バイオシミラーのみ使用した患者は月あたり平均支払者コストが3820ドル低く、月あたり平均自己負担コストが39.50ドル低かった。結論および関連性：本コホート研究の結果は、バイオシミラー参入が腫瘍領域の参照バイオロジクスにおけるASP低下および市場シェア減少と関連したことを示唆する。バイオシミラーがもたらした市場競争は、支払者コストの低下および患者の経済的負担の軽減とも関連した。

Abstract (original)

IMPORTANCE: Biosimilars are highly similar to originator biologics and were introduced to increase market competition, lower the price of biologics, and expand patient access by improving affordability. By the end of 2024, three anticancer biologics have experienced biosimilar entry in the US (bevacizumab, rituximab, and trastuzumab), underscoring the need to evaluate their financial implications for payers and patients. OBJECTIVE: To assess market dynamics and examine financial implications associated with biosimilar use patterns among patients who received bevacizumab, rituximab, or trastuzumab. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This retrospective cohort examined price and market share trends and payer and patient costs after biosimilar entry. It used data from the Merative MarketScan commercial database and Medicare database from July 2019 to December 2024. Based on use patterns within 12 months of treatment initiation, patients were categorized into 4 groups: those who exclusively used biosimilars, exclusively used the reference product (ie, originator biologics), switched from the reference product to biosimilars, and switched from biosimilars to the reference product. Data were analyzed between September 2025 and March 2026. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary study outcomes were average sales price (ASP), market share of reference products, and mean monthly payer and out-of-pocket costs within the study period. RESULTS: Among 14 655 patients in this study, the mean (SD) age was 57 (13) years, 9985 (68.1%) were female, and the most common cancers were breast cancer (5182 [35.4%]), lymphoma (4320 [29.5%]), and colorectal cancer (1998 [13.6%]). A total of 8710 patients (59.4%) exclusively used biosimilars, 4760 (32.5%) exclusively used the reference product, 1015 (6.9%) switched from the reference product to biosimilars, and 170 (1.2%) switched from biosimilars to the reference product. After biosimilar entry, the ASP of the 3 reference products declined by an average of 3.8% annually. Their market share decreased 30% annually in commercial insurance and 31.5% in the Medicare Part B market. Compared with patients who only used the reference product, those who only used biosimilars rendered a $3820 lower mean monthly payer cost and $39.50 lower mean monthly out-of-pocket cost. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: The results of this cohort study suggest that biosimilar entry was associated with lower ASP and reduced market share for reference biologics in oncology. Market competition introduced by biosimilars was also associated with lowered payer costs and reduced patient financial burden.

DOI: 10.1001/jamaoncol.2026.3128 · PMID: 42658505
